blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla announced on Friday that he will file complaints against vloggers and Facebook pages spreading false information on his health and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez’s case at the Sandiganbayan. He said the Office of the Ombudsman will file complaints with the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) and Facebook. “People are trying to create doubt about the office or maybe even the state of my health, and I think this has to stop. We are filing a complaint with the DICT and Facebook to stop the proliferation of fake news. Obviously, it is […]...
